text:
emma: Quick flag: migration dashboard shows spikes where a single request is counted under both v1 and v2. Suspect header normalization at ingress. Anyone seen header rewrite rules recently?

jon: Confirmed. Saw traces where edge had X-Client-Ver=v2 but internal proxy saw nothing.

priya: Logs: 
```
2025-01-11T14:03:12Z edge id=aa1 headers={X-Client-Ver:v2, Authorization:****} forwarded=true
2025-01-11T14:03:12Z svc-proxy id=aa1 headers={Authorization:****} variant=v1
```
So header drop between edge->svc-proxy.

sanjay: Ingress team recently enabled header-sanitizer to remove unknown headers for caching. This likely caught X-Client-Ver.

billing-bot: Impact: meter ingestion increments are based on (pre-auth header) and (runtime variant). When header and runtime disagree we double-count.

console-product: UX issue: our "v2 adoption" panel mixes client-claimed and runtime-observed counts. That hides rollback/strip problems.

jon: Proposal: 1) pick canonical header name (X-Redwood-Client-Ver) and add it to passthrough allowlist; 2) edge should stamp span.tag client.version at ingress so traces keep original value; 3) meter ingestion dedupe on request_id+tenant with short window.

priya: Agree. Also add span.tag header_propagation=ok|stripped to help postmortems.

infra-bot: PR queued: ingress/allowlist -> includes X-Redwood-Client-Ver. CI checks added. ETA 2h.

billing-bot: We'll implement dedupe in meters (request_id, tenant, 5s window) behind a flag in staging and run comparisons.

console-product: We'll split the adoption chart into two series: client-reported vs routing-observed and add tooltip copy: "Routing-observed used for billing."

qa-bot: Integration test: simulate header present at edge, removed by sanitizer, assert span.client.version set at ingress, meter dedupe prevents double-count. Add to nightly.

emma: Action list agreed: infra allowlist + ingress stamping (infra + jon), meter dedupe flag rollout (billing), console chart split + copy (console-product), QA test + runbook (qa). Monitor divergence alert for 48h after rollout.

jon: Minor extra: communicate canonical header to SDKs and partners and add deprecation note for older header names.

priya: I'll coordinate update to migration guide and add note in SDK changelog.

emma: Thanks. Let's reconvene if staging diffs >0.5% after deploy. :thumbsup:
